test_read_history_capped: test that the read_history set in file_tools._read_tracker is bounded by _READ_HISTORY_CAP
test_dedup_capped_oldest_first: test that the dedup dict in file_tools._read_tracker is capped with oldest entries evicted first
test_read_timestamps_capped_oldest_first: test that the read_timestamps dict in file_tools._read_tracker is capped with oldest entries evicted first
test_cap_is_idempotent_under_cap: test that _cap_read_tracker_data is a no-op when containers are under their cap limits
test_prune_drops_completion_entry_with_e: test that ProcessRegistry._prune_if_needed clears _completion_consumed for expired finished sessions
